note: Sleeper user_id -> Discord user id, for the @mention in a news alert. Discord user ids are NOT secrets: every member of a server can see them, so this file is committed. Webhook URLs ARE secrets and live only in the environment (DISCORD_WEBHOOK_STAGING / DISCORD_WEBHOOK_LIVE) — never put one here.
how_to_fill: In Discord: User Settings -> Advanced -> Developer Mode on, then right-click a member -> Copy User ID. Paste it over the placeholder. 17-20 digits. discord-notify.mjs refuses to build a payload for an all-zero id, so a half-filled map fails loudly instead of quietly skipping somebody.
